neighbours.label: Names of New Testament epistles ending in -ians (Colossians, Corinthians, Galatians, Ephesians), in scripture citations
fire: The preacher turned to Colossians 3:4 and read the verse about being revealed in glory.
Paul's greeting in 2 Corinthians 4:6 is often quoted at the start of the service.
We studied Galatians 3:1 together and talked about faith and the law over coffee.
A young man read a long passage from Ephesians 2:8 at the wedding ceremony.
She underlined the words of Philippians 4:13 in her old pocket Bible.
In 1 Corinthians 14 the apostle writes at length about gifts and order in worship.
Our small group has spent the whole autumn working through Colossians one chapter a week.
He quoted Galatians from memory while the class waited quietly.
quiet: The preacher turned to Romans 3:4 and read the verse about God being true.
Paul's greeting in Hebrews 4:6 is often quoted at the start of the service.
We studied Genesis 3:1 together and talked about the garden over coffee.
A young man read a long passage from Psalms 23:1 at the wedding ceremony.
She underlined the words of Isaiah 40:31 in her old pocket Bible.
In Matthew 14 the gospel writer tells at length about the feeding of the crowd.
Our small group has spent the whole autumn working through Exodus one chapter a week.
He quoted Proverbs from memory while the class waited quietly.
